what: The same content as the clean fixtures, drawn wrong on purpose: a chart placeholder and a table placeholder with no declared role, an empty outlined box, a white secondary button, and no heading to name the screen.
why: A corpus where every fixture reads perfectly cannot detect a change that makes everything read as `card` with no `?`. This one asserts the failures are still failures. It reproduces both worked examples from references/wireframe-conventions.md — the plot that reads as `shape`, and the white button that reads as `input?`.
notes: Non-zero fallbacks are the point. Do not 'fix' this fixture by declaring roles on it — declare them on a copy if a clean variant is ever wanted.
`unnamedScreens: 1` is the other half: the screen has no heading of any size, so nothing can name it.

The conventions doc predicted the table placeholder would read as `input?`; it reads as `shape`. The doc is describing the shape of the failure, not this exact drawing — both are the same category of miss.
